What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [lola](@/work/lola.md): Loader & Launcher of Modular NodeJS Apps.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Jasmine: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic.
